title: Penang recycling locations — sourced research candidates
coverage: Partial research, not an exhaustive or independently verified directory. Includes source-listed community facilities, recycling centres and used-cooking-oil-only bins. Possible duplicates remain.
notes: The operator lists three entries as closed or relocated; retained with explicit status.
The 2024 council list may be outdated; do not assume hours, materials or current operation.
Potential overlaps between the council and operator lists require manual site-level review.
The supplied September 2005 PDF is historical and is not treated as evidence of current operation.
MAMPAN contains other types of sustainable businesses; only selected named recycling or collection sites are included.
RECYCLEnCASH coordinates and Google Maps links are operator-provided, not independently checked on the ground; community access and accepted materials must be confirmed.
MAMPAN material descriptions are historical source claims and must be confirmed before use.
Google Maps short links could not be opened by the research browser; they are operator-supplied links, not independently verified Google Maps results.
PGC household hazardous waste collection information was last updated in July 2024; accepted items and operation require confirmation.
Historical KITAR apartment programme areas are kept separately because they are not confirmed public drop-off sites.

2026-11-09 audit: corrected broken MBPP source URL, consolidated three repeated venue records, and added two omitted council-listed locations. PGC programme acceptance details are not a guarantee of present operation.
Coordinates added from individual MAMPAN records and previously source-reviewed operator destination links; coordinates do not establish present operation or public access.
